b: Civilization VII launched back in February 2025, and in the almost two years since, its developers at Firaxis have continued to grow-–and sometimes even overhaul—the Civ VII experience based on community input and feedback, with some of the biggest and most exciting additions still on the horizon.

Along with the massive Test of Time update, which lets you play as the same civ through every Age, we've released over 15 major Game Updates for all players, including significant changes like reworked Victories and a brand-new Triumphs system, myriad map types and improved map generation, extensive UI improvements and added quality-of-life features, and much more.
Now through November 30 at 10AM PT, we invite everyone who has enjoyed Civ VII's updates to nominate the game for the Labor of Love category in the 2026 Steam Awards.

Looking toward the future, we unveiled Arc of Tomorrow* earlier this year, the next huge update that introduces a fourth Age (the Atomic Age) to the base game, which will be free for all players when it releases in 2027. Later next year, we'll also release Earthrise**, a paid expansion for Civilization VII that will see your civ reach for the stars as it adapts to a changing world. Earthrise is available to wishlist now on Steam, and you can learn more here about what we have planned for it.
*Base game required. This content is free for all owners of Civilization VII and will be delivered automatically in-game on release. Terms apply.
**Base game required. Some content requires unlocking via gameplay.
